topics.name: Vacc
topics.desc: Integrated USMLE-style Anki recall: Saudi MOH 2019 schedule plus vaccine mechanisms and clinical risk groups. Historical schedule, verify current guidance.

cards.q: Infant backbone: what is given at 2, 4, and 6 months in this chart?
cards.a: 2 & 4 mo: HepB, RV, DTaP, Hib, PCV, IPV. 6 mo: same six + BCG + OPV. Anchor: 2=4; 6 adds BCG/OPV.

cards.q: Birth→12 mo: recite the entire age-based schedule.
cards.a: Birth HepB; 2/4 mo HepB+RV+DTaP+Hib+PCV+IPV; 6 mo same +BCG+OPV; 9 mo measles+MCV4; 12 mo PCV+OPV+MCV4+MMR.

cards.q: Compare vaccines at 12, 18, 24 mo and 4–6 yr.
Which scheduled vaccines are live? Contrast OPV vs IPV.
cards.a: Live: BCG, RV, OPV, MMR, varicella. IPV is inactivated; OPV is live oral. Live vaccines generally avoided in severe immunodeficiency.

cards.q: At 9 vs 12 mo, what measles and meningococcal vaccines appear?
cards.a: 9 mo: measles-only + MCV4. 12 mo: MMR + MCV4 (also PCV+OPV). MMR covers measles/mumps/rubella; MCV4 covers A,C,W,Y.

cards.q: What are the adolescent vaccine anchors in this 2019 chart?
cards.a: 11 yr: Tdap+HPV; 12 yr: HPV; 18 yr: MCV4. Chart lists HPV for females; current eligibility/schedules may differ.

cards.q: Pregnancy: what vaccines are recommended vs avoided?
cards.a: Tdap each pregnancy at 27–36 wk; inactivated influenza annually in season. MMR and varicella are live and contraindicated; HepB if indicated.

cards.q: Adult schedule: group the major intervals and indications.
cards.a: Flu yearly; Td/Tdap booster every 10 yr; MMR 1–2 doses if susceptible; varicella 2 doses; HepB 0,1,6 mo; zoster 2 doses 2–6 mo apart (chart); MCV4 booster q5yr if risk.

cards.q: PCV vs PPSV23: compare mechanism and clinical implications.
cards.a: PCV: conjugate, T-cell-dependent, immune memory. PPSV23: polysaccharide, mainly T-cell-independent; poor responses in children <2 yr. Adult use is age/risk/history dependent.

cards.q: Which risk groups require special vaccination attention?
cards.a: Asplenia: pneumococcal, meningococcal, Hib. Immunocompromise: risk-based vaccines; caution with live vaccines. Liver disease: assess HepA/HepB. Older adults: flu, pneumococcal, zoster.
